title: Stale grounded status after parent switch in DODAG
description:
In dodag.py, ParentCandidate stores gateway_centric but not grounded. When select_parent() switches to a new preferred parent (due to hysteresis being overcome or old parent being pruned/removed), self.gateway_centric is updated from best.gateway_centric (line 730), but self.grounded retains the previous parent's value. The node continues advertising the wrong Grounded bit in DIOs until it receives a new DIO from the current parent.

Location: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:730

Fix: add grounded field to ParentCandidate, pass dio.grounded when creating candidates (line 450), and update self.grounded = best.grounded in select_parent() after line 730.
